prompt:
A horizontal strip of pixel art showing the vertical FRONT FACE of a raised wall/ledge, exactly as such faces look in a top-down JRPG map (we look straight at the face; it is the drop between an upper level and the floor). It fills the whole image edge to edge: the top 6% is the lit rim/lip of the upper surface, the face below gets gradually darker toward the bottom, and the bottom 8% is a dark contact band where it meets the floor. No floor, no sky, no objects in front. SEAMLESS horizontally (left edge continues into the right edge). The strip is about 256 x 128 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels). Material: a harbour quay / town retaining wall of large cut grey stone blocks in courses, mortar lines, some moss and a dark wet waterline stain near the bottom.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
revised_prompt: Generate a wide horizontal seamless tileable pixel-art texture, aspect ratio 2:1, designed as 256 x 128 ART PIXELS enlarged with nearest-neighbor to approximately 2048 x 1024 displayed pixels (uniform 8x8 display squares, absolutely no subpixel detail). Show ONLY the straight-on vertical FRONT FACE of a raised harbour quay / town retaining wall, as in a top-down JRPG map: the drop between upper level and lower level, not a wall seen from above. Entire frame edge-to-edge wall. Top 6% narrow illuminated stone rim/lip, below it large worn cut grey stone blocks in horizontal courses, distinctly hand-placed mortar joints with staggered block lengths; wall face shades gradually darker towards bottom, bottom 8% dark contact band and irregular dark wet waterline stain with a little sparse moss. NO visible upper surface, floor, water, sky, or foreground objects. Left and right boundaries of blocks, mortar lines, moss and stains must tile perfectly horizontally (seamless wrap, periodic texture). Premium modern hi-bit JRPG 2D pixel art, carefully composed crisp square pixel clusters of 3-10 art pixels, sharp hard edges, 4-6 coherent shades per material, rich earthy stone greys, warm yellow-tinted highlights, more saturated muted purple-red shadows. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast-evening illumination, CLEAN BASE COLOURS without game-engine night lighting. No cast shadows, no lamps, no glow, no vignette, no blur, no antialiasing, no brushes, no photographic texture, no speckly noise, no checkerboard dithering. A perfectly flat frontal orthographic pixel-art wall texture, not isometric.
